project_type: Node.js 22 ESM ("type":"module") — plain ES modules, no framework. Browser frontend + Node engine + Node server. Windows local dev machine.
build_system: No build step. Scripts run directly with node. IMPORTANT: project uses "type":"module" so all files must be .js ESM with import/export. No CommonJS require().
test_framework: Node.js built-in test runner (node:test + node:assert/strict). Tests: tests/data.test.js, tests/engine.test.js, tests/ui.test.js. New tests go in tests/.
verification_instructions: 1. Run node --test "tests/*.test.js" from project root — all tests must pass. 2. Start server: node server/index.js (defaults port 3001). 3. POST synthetic patient to http://localhost:3001/api/evaluate and confirm response has {findings, missingInformation, evidence, ruleSetVersion, disclaimer, dataAttributions} and NO numeric score field. 4. node scripts/synthetic_demo.js — confirm 'SYNTHETIC DATA' banner and category distribution. 5. Kill server.
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell. NO npm install — only node built-ins (node:http, node:fs, node:path, node:url, node:readline, node:net, node:test, node:assert) and jsdom (already in devDependencies). No new npm dependencies. Engine internals under engine/ are read-only (only add new files elsewhere).
contribution_requirements: No numeric safety score anywhere. Seven categories only: avoid > modify > conditional > monitor > needs_info > informational > no_flag. Missing data is never normal. Model output never overrides rules. ClinPGx CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution required. Disclaimer on every output. Auth stub + audit log + 'real patient data MUST NOT be used until security/ethics review' warning required in server code.
key_patterns: Engine: loadDatasetFromFs(root) loads dataset from filesystem; evaluatePatientAsync(rawPatient, ds) runs full evaluation; normalizePatient(raw, ds) validates input and returns {errors,warnings}. Test helpers: helpers.js exports ds, run, drug, base, cat, ROOT. Reference cases: tests/fixtures/reference_cases.js exports CASES, NOW, BASE. Scripts: use fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url)) NOT .pathname (Windows path bug). Report: DISCLAIMER and ATTRIBUTION constants live in engine/report.js.
relevant_files: engine/index.js — exports evaluatePatientAsync, evaluatePatient, normalizePatient, loadDatasetFromFs, CATEGORIES, PRECEDENCE, ENGINE_VERSION
engine/patient.js — normalizePatient implementation (the validation the server must reuse)
engine/dataset.js — loadDatasetFromFs pattern (uses fileURLToPath for paths)
tests/helpers.js — ROOT export BUG: uses .pathname instead of fileURLToPath; this must be fixed
tests/engine.test.js — test style to follow (node:test, node:assert/strict)
tests/fixtures/reference_cases.js — BASE patient template and geno() helper for synthetic data
scripts/bench.mjs — existing script pattern (same path bug present; fix in new scripts)
frontend/ui/dom.js — h() function for safe DOM construction (no innerHTML)
frontend/ui/app.js — initApp(ds) pattern; where to call renderResearchPanel
frontend/ui/results.js — ATTRIBUTION constant export used by UI
frontend/genomx-advisor.html — CSP: connect-src 'self' allows same-origin fetch
data/genes.json — gene list with phenotypes (used for synthetic demo)
data/model/ — empty directory; assoc_scores.parquet does not exist yet
directory_structure: engine/ — rule engine (read-only: add no files here) | data/ — JSON knowledge base (rules/, adverse/, guidelines/, tggates/, model/) | frontend/ — browser UI (ui/main.js entry, ui/app.js, ui/dom.js, ui/form.js, ui/results.js, ui/graph.js) | tests/ — test files + fixtures/ | scripts/ — ingest/bench/validate scripts (existing) | genomex-final/api/ — NEW: Node.js HTTP API server, batch CLI, synthetic demo, documentation, and copy of research panel | .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts. NOTE: New server/scripts/docs go in genomex-final/api/; frontend panel primary is frontend/ui/ with a copy in genomex-final/api/; tests stay in tests/.
output_location_override: All new server and script files go in genomex-final/api/ (not in server/ or scripts/). Import paths from genomex-final/api/ must use '../../engine/...' (two levels up). Dataset root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../..', import.meta.url)). Tests stay in tests/ and import from '../genomex-final/api/index.js'.
